name: Volume Shading Model
definition: Computes final fragment color by combining indirect diffuse, indirect specular, emissivity, transparency/refraction, and direct light contributions, with shadow blending and gamma correction.
summary: The Volume Shading Model is a local illumination technique that calculates diffuse and specular contributions based on scalar data and gradients, distinguishing itself by managing the interplay between material opacity and light transport modes within a single pass.
